doc.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Touring Europe with Wilber, Vignola and Duffy Jackson
summary: He tours Europe a few times a year with Wilber, Vignola and a trio with Duffy Jackson.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. I’ve been doing Europe two or three times a year, either with Bob Wilber, or I went over with Frank Vignola, the guitarist, he did a little Django group there a little over a year ago, and who else — John Coliani, the pianist did a trio with Duffy Jackson, and the three of us. That was funny. That was a funny experience, I mean just being on the road with Duffy was something right there.
You know his father was here yesterday.
First time I met him. I’ve known Duffy for years, and I just saw Chubby for the first day yesterday. I wish he could have hung out a little longer, it would have been nice.
